landing.governmentBadge: Government of Springfield · Smart City Initiative
landing.heroTitle: AI-Powered Civic Grievance Management for Smart Cities
landing.heroDescription: Report potholes, water leaks, garbage, and streetlight issues in minutes. Our AI engine automatically categorizes, prioritizes, and routes every complaint to the right department — so your city resolves problems faster.

workflow.title: Our Smart Workflow
workflow.citizenReportsDesc: Citizens file complaints with photos and location details through the portal.
workflow.aiAnalysisDesc: AI engine detects category, severity, and auto-assigns the correct department.
workflow.officerActionDesc: Field officers receive assignments, inspect sites, and update progress in real time.
workflow.trackResolveDesc: Citizens track status live; admins monitor performance with analytics dashboards.

citizenBenefits.title: Why Citizens Love CivicPulse
citizenBenefits.reportMinutesDesc: File a complaint with a photo and location — no paperwork, no office visits.
citizenBenefits.aiRoutingDesc: Your complaint is automatically categorized and sent to the right department.
citizenBenefits.liveTrackingDesc: Track progress from submission to resolution with real-time status updates.
citizenBenefits.transparentDesc: See who is handling your complaint and the full history of actions taken.

municipalBenefits.title: Smart City Benefits
municipalBenefits.intelligentTriageDesc: AI prioritizes critical issues like school-zone hazards automatically.
municipalBenefits.analyticsDesc: Measure resolution times, officer performance, and ward-level trends.
municipalBenefits.satisfactionDesc: Build trust with transparent, trackable, and responsive grievance handling.
municipalBenefits.optimizationDesc: Assign field crews efficiently based on severity and workload data.

landing.processDescription: नागरिक अहवालापासून निराकरणापर्यंत, पारदर्शक AI-सहाय्यित कार्यप्रवाह सर्वांना माहिती देतो.
landing.ctaTitle: तुमचे शहर अधिक responsive बनवण्यास तयार?
landing.ctaDescription: CivicPulse AI वापरून हजारो नागरिक आणि अधिकारी स्वच्छ, सुरक्षित परिसर तयार करत आहेत.
landing.footerDescription: नगरपालिकांसाठी AI-संचालित नागरिक तक्रार अहवाल आणि निराकरण व्यासपीठ. पारदर्शक, कार्यक्षम आणि नागरिक-अनुकूल शासनासाठी.
